purpose: Test targeted risk controls after repeated clean prospective misses without retroactively changing v0.1.0.

limited_history_fallback.effective_sample_caution: Four losses are the same Porter Martone player-game cluster, so seven bets are not seven independent observations.

sub_25pct_anytime_goal.note: Zero wins is poor but still plausible at these low base rates; this is a shadow review trigger, not proof of a permanent exclusion rule.

shadow_rules: Apply the normal official Playable Price gate first.
Withhold model_basis=limited_history_fallback (and equivalent tagged fallback rows) from the shadow card.
Withhold anytime_goal candidates with model_probability < 0.25 from the shadow card.
Do not alter model probabilities, Top 10 ranking, or the official v0.1.0 Playable Price card.
Track shadow results prospectively before any promotion.

retrospective_diagnostic_only.warning: The shadow rules were chosen after seeing these results, so retrospective improvement is not evidence for promotion.

promotion_rule.note: Prospective evidence only; clustered same-player bets count as one diagnostic cluster when judging independence.
